writing this review to share my personal experience with Munroe Medical during my CORU registration process, in the hope that it may save others from the time, stress, and money I’ve lost.

After making my payment, the level of communication I received dropped drastically. In my experience, there was significant delay in
responses, and at times it felt like my messages were being completely ignored. The lack of guidance and clarity throughout the process made things unnecessarily frustrating and stressful.

What was most disappointing was the feeling that, once the payment was completed, the support I expected was no longer there. For something as important and time-sensitive as CORU registration, this was incredibly disheartening.

This review reflects my own experience, but I strongly encourage others to be cautious and do thorough research before choosing any service provider.
